description: Full build of the internal physical therapy business app — Kotlin backend (Javalin + PostgreSQL) through Android, iOS, and Windows Desktop clients (Kotlin Multiplatform + Compose Multiplatform).

technologyStack.backend: Kotlin (JVM), Javalin web framework, HikariCP, Exposed ORM (DSL), kotlin-logging, Logback, dotenv-kotlin
technologyStack.database: PostgreSQL 15+ (required for partial predicate on EXCLUDE constraint), Flyway migrations
technologyStack.infrastructure: Docker, Docker Compose, Oracle Cloud Free Tier ARM VM (4 cores, 24GB RAM), Coolify PaaS, Let's Encrypt automated TLS
technologyStack.mobileAndDesktopUI: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), Compose Multiplatform, Ktor HTTP Client (platform engines: OkHttp for Android, Darwin for iOS, CIO for Desktop), kotlinx.serialization, kotlinx.coroutines
technologyStack.security: JWT authentication (24h expiry), bcrypt password hashing, in-memory ConcurrentHashMap JWT deny list for deactivations

roles.SUPERUSER: Full developer/owner god mode. Access to all operational and system data.
roles.OWNER: Business owner. Edit access to home branches and currently checked-in branch. View-only access to all branches. Can manage users. Cannot edit PAST/REMITTED financial records.
roles.MANAGER: Superset of COORDINATOR. Assigns home branches, manages medical mission delegates, can work on clients.
roles.COORDINATOR: Handles finance/remittance for assigned branches. Sole editor of PAST/REMITTED records for their branch.
roles.PRACTITIONER: Logs sessions, views clients, manages inventory. Full access to home branches and currently checked-in branch.
roles.ACCOUNTANT: Read-only access to sales, product sales, and remittances for all branches.
roles.VIEWER: Read-only access. Reserved for future use.

branchTypes.PROVINCIAL_TOUR: Temporary off-site event, treated as a standalone branch.
branchTypes.MEDICAL_MISSION: Free event branch. Always ₱0 sessions. Delegate-managed.

sessionTypes.REGULAR: First non-medical-mission visit anywhere, at a CLINIC branch (Default ₱2,500).
sessionTypes.PROVINCIAL_FIRST: First non-medical-mission visit anywhere, at a PROVINCIAL_TOUR branch (Default ₱3,500).
sessionTypes.SECOND_SESSION: Exactly one prior non-medical-mission session globally (Default ₱2,000).
sessionTypes.SUBSEQUENT: Two or more prior non-medical-mission sessions globally (Default ₱1,500).
sessionTypes.MEDICAL_MISSION: Any visit at a medical mission branch. Always free (₱0) and never counts toward history.

inventoryMovements.SAMPLE: Unit given as a free sample (quantity_change < 0).
inventoryMovements.MISSING: Unit unaccounted for. Requires mandatory reason/notes (quantity_change < 0).
inventoryMovements.ADJUSTMENT: Manual inventory correction (quantity_change of either sign).

inventoryMetrics.Available: Derived value: Available = Stock - Sales - Tester - Sample - Missing.

projectRules.capabilitySystem: All operational permission checks MUST traverse the active_user_capabilities view. Role memberships are only used to seed initial capability assignments in the V2/V3 migrations and are never queried at runtime in the service logic. hasCapability(userId, capabilityCode, contextType, contextId) is checked at the top of every mutating service layer method. Inactive user immediate revocation is managed via a server-side deny list of user IDs in a ConcurrentHashMap, checked by JWT middleware.
projectRules.dayStateMachine: Transitions from OPEN to PAST occur lazily at 04:00 AM Asia/Manila of the following day. All operational writes must check the day status via assertEditable. Edits on PAST or REMITTED days require EDIT_PAST_DAY capability. Edits on REMITTED days are flagged, require a non-null reason in the request body, and generate flagged audit entries that must be acknowledged by Owners or Accountants.
projectRules.concurrencyRules: Optimistic locking is enforced on session, branch_inventory, and remittance tables using a version column (mismatches return HTTP 409). Row-level lock via SELECT FOR UPDATE on client row is acquired during session creation to prevent concurrent session booking races. For sales, SELECT FOR UPDATE on branch_inventory and stock level validation are executed in a single transaction. Remittance submission runs in SERIALIZABLE isolation and locks the remittance row via SELECT FOR UPDATE.
projectRules.idempotency: All mutating INSERT operations use a client-generated UUID as primary key. Upon duplicate key insertion (Unique Violation), the server returns the existing row with HTTP 200/201. Clock-out is an UPDATE query designed to be idempotent (setting the same timestamp is a no-op).
projectRules.auditLogging: Audit entries are written in the service layer only for all operational and financial tables. Every INSERT, UPDATE, and soft-DELETE must write an audit log entry. Changes on REMITTED days must be flagged (is_flagged = true) and require a reason.
projectRules.reliefDuty: Clocking into a non-home branch automatically assigns view-only access. Edit access requires sending a request to a clocked-in user. Upon grant, a user_capability row is written with valid_to set to the 4 AM Manila boundary of the next day (stored as UTC) with priority 10. Compensation for relief duty is paid from the drawer of the performing branch.
projectRules.commissionPool: Product commission is a flat amount added on top of unit price. All commissions collected for the day are pooled and split equally among all practitioners and coordinators clocked in at the sold_at time. Manual inclusions/exclusions can override this. No auto-recalculation on PAST/REMITTED days unless manually triggered.
projectRules.remittanceFlows: Two independent flows: SESSION (net = gross session income - total compensation - total expenses) and PRODUCT (quantity * unit price). Draft remittances can overlap and are not constrained by no_remittance_overlap EXCLUDE constraint. Submission writes an immutable financial snapshot (SESSION only) and transitions the covered branch days to REMITTED.
projectRules.branchSlotOrdering: Cosmetic slot numbers control practitioner display order in reports and sessions. Slot 1 is senior. Swapping is atomic. Determines display order in reports. Relief practitioners appear after home slots in reports.
projectRules.allowancesAndExpenses: Expenses are company costs logged by anyone. Allowances are non-remitted payments (e.g. medical mission transport) paid by Owner, distinct from regular compensation.
projectRules.clientAnonymization: Anonymization soft-deletes client and nullifies name, phone, address, conditions, BP. Gender and age are retained for reports.
projectRules.medicalMissionDelegate: Managers assigned as medical mission delegates receive EDIT_BRANCH_DATA scoped to the mission branch via user_capability with priority 20 written in a single transaction.
projectRules.clientSearch: Fuzzy client name matching via pg_trgm ILIKE plus exact phone prefix matching.
projectRules.nextAppointmentAlerts: Daily scheduled task at 07:00 AM Manila queries completed sessions with next appointment in 2 days and writes notifications.

steps: 1. Guard: Check if branch_day.status is OPEN. If not, abort unless manually run by Coordinator.
2. Fetch all non-voided product sales for the branch_day.
3. For each sale, find attendance-eligible users whose clock-in/out window covers sold_at.
4. Apply manual inclusions (force add) and exclusions (force remove) from commission_manual_inclusion.
5. If eligible users exist, split (sale.commission_amount_at_time * sale.quantity) equally using BigDecimal division.
6. Accumulate totals per user and batch upsert to commission_split.
7. Delete any users from commission_split for that branch_day who no longer have any eligible commission.

assign: 1. Inside a single transaction, insert medical_mission_delegate record (target_user, assigned_by).

3. Insert user_capability: user_id=target_user_id, capability_id=EDIT_BRANCH_DATA, context_type=BRANCH, context_id=branch_id, source_type=MEDICAL_MISSION_DELEGATE, source_id=delegate_id, priority=20, valid_from=now(), valid_to=NULL.
revoke: 1. Inside a single transaction, set ended_at = now() on medical_mission_delegate.
2. Update user_capability: set valid_to = now() where source_type=MEDICAL_MISSION_DELEGATE and source_id=delegate_id.

steps: 1. Begin transaction at SERIALIZABLE isolation level.
2. Lock and fetch remittance: SELECT id, status, version FROM remittance WHERE id = :remittance_id FOR UPDATE.
3. Assert status is DRAFT and version is expected_version.
4. Calculate gross_income: SUM(remittance_line.amount) for non-deleted lines of type SESSION.
5. Calculate total_compensation: SUM(compensation.amount) for paying_branch_day_ids in remittance_day_breakdown.
6. Calculate total_expenses: SUM(expense.amount) for branch_day_ids in remittance_day_breakdown where deleted_at IS NULL.

8. For SESSION remittances, insert remittance_financial_snapshot: gross_income, total_compensation, total_expenses, net_income (DB trigger fn_remittance_snapshot_immutable blocks subsequent updates/deletes).
9. Update remittance: status=SUBMITTED, version=version+1, submitted_date=today (Manila date).
10. Transition all covered branch_day rows to status=REMITTED.
11. Write audit log entries for remittance and each branch_day update, then commit.

logic: 1. If branch_type is MEDICAL_MISSION, return MEDICAL_MISSION.
2. Count non-voided, non-MEDICAL_MISSION sessions for client_id across all branches (using active_session_voids view).
3. If branch_type is PROVINCIAL_TOUR and count is 0, return PROVINCIAL_FIRST.

userStories.title: CapabilityService.hasCapability + JWT deny list
userStories.description: As the backend, I need a central capability check method and an in-memory deny list so that all auth checks go through one path and inactive users are immediately blocked.
requirements: Implement CapabilityService.hasCapability(userId, capabilityCode, contextType, contextId): Boolean querying active_user_capabilities
Ensure no direct role checks are executed in business logic
Maintain ConcurrentHashMap<UUID, Instant> deny list populated from app_user WHERE status='INACTIVE' at startup
Evict deny list records older than 24 hours (JWT max expiry)
Check deny list in JWT middleware before making database requests
acceptanceCriteria: Capability queries correctly inspect active_user_capabilities view
Inactive users are immediately blocked with HTTP 401 on in-flight requests
Auth check returns false if user is inactive, or has expired time window, or lacks matching row
verification: Unit tests for hasCapability and deny list pass
userStories.notes: active_user_capabilities view is already defined in V1__full_schema.sql. contextType maps to capability_context_type enum.

userStories.title: BranchDayService — resolveOrCreate and assertEditable
userStories.description: As the backend, I need a shared service to resolve or create a branch_day row and assert it is editable so that every other module can call it before any write.
requirements: BranchDayService.resolveOrCreate(branchId: UUID, date: LocalDate): BranchDay executes an UPSERT (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) and returns the record
BranchDayService.assertEditable(branchDayId: UUID, userId: UUID) evaluates day state: if date < today (Asia/Manila) and status is OPEN, treat as PAST
Require EDIT_PAST_DAY capability for writes on PAST or REMITTED days (throw 403 Forbidden)
Enforce mandatory non-null reason for writes on REMITTED days (throw 400 Bad Request if missing)
Enforce 4 AM Manila boundary when converting branch calendar date to UTC expiration timestamps
acceptanceCriteria: Branch day is lazily evaluated on each request based on current Asia/Manila time
Throws 403 Forbidden on writes to PAST/REMITTED days for unauthorized users
Throws 400 Bad Request on writes to REMITTED days if reason is absent
verification: Unit tests for resolveOrCreate and assertEditable pass
userStories.notes: 4AM Manila boundary: branchDate.plusDays(1).atTime(4,0).atZone(ZoneId.of('Asia/Manila')). Called by every service before any financial or operational write.
